verdict.rationale: Maritime is an AI agent hosting platform that offers metered LLM access, so a training-data opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains no documented policy or setting that keeps user data out of model training. Encrypted secret variables and scoped API keys are adjacent security controls, not a training opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
